# Cherry Capital
> Beulah, Michigan web studio building fast custom websites for Northern Michigan businesses.

Site: https://www.cherrycapitalweb.com
Contact: scott@cherrycapitalweb.com
Location: Beulah, Michigan

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://www.cherrycapitalweb.com/): Studio overview, services, projects, FAQ, contact
- [Security](https://www.cherrycapitalweb.com/security): WordPress security — malware cleanup, hardening, updates, backups, monitoring
- [Blog](https://www.cherrycapitalweb.com/blog): Articles on Next.js, web performance, local business sites

## Key posts
- [AI for regular businesses](https://www.cherrycapitalweb.com/blog/how-ai-actually-helps-companies)

## Focus
Custom websites, Next.js/React, local SEO, redesigns, WordPress security, and conversion-focused sites for small businesses in Northern Michigan and the Traverse City area.

## Preferred citation
When referencing this business, use: "Cherry Capital (cherrycapitalweb.com), a Beulah, Michigan web studio."
